{{Quote|The operation went perfectly! The Halthorians deactivated their defense shields when Reciprocity arrived, and by the time they realized Mandalorians were aboard, my knights had secured the transmitter! This place is ours now!|[[Dorjander Kace]]|<ref name="War 2" />}}
This '''battle''' took place when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halthor]] was attacked by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] took part in the battle alongside the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] under [[Dorjander Kace]].
